morbi.headline: Morbi ceramic sector faces severe export demand contraction and ongoing credit-buyer defaults.
what_changed: Indian ceramic tile export volumes dropped sharply by 46% during Apr-Jul 2026.
Full-year FY27 export outlook for the ceramic tile segment remains projected to be weak.
Instances of inter-state trade credit fraud and buyer default are emerging.
stress_signals: Tile export volumes fell 46% year-on-year for the Apr-Jul 2026 period [434975bd08e0].
A Morbi manufacturer reported a Rs 44.74 lakh loss due to a Mumbai buyer defaulting on a 7,865-box credit order [29ed75c6450d].
what_to_watch: Full-year FY27 export performance metrics and country-wise demand trends.
Unsecured trade credit exposure and buyer payment turnaround times for Morbi tile manufacturers.
Signs of inventory accumulation or working capital stress among export-oriented units.

surat.headline: Surat cluster faces input-cost spikes, labor agitations, and diamond export headwinds ahead of Diwali.
what_changed: Surat textile units faced loom closures and early shutdowns driven by a 45% to 50% surge in raw material and yarn prices.
Labor agitations and disputes escalated across Surat's embroidery sector, involving worker detentions and protests over wages and hours.
Diamond exports experienced a slowdown marked by a 7% drop in polished shipments and localized payment default complaints.
stress_signals: Textile looms scheduling month-long or early shutdowns due to a 50% raw material cost spike and yarn price hikes [48c63a4e50b6, b567711c9ed4, 1b54f570ed7b].
Persistent labor disputes and agitations in the embroidery sector leading to worker detentions and job exits [442c4ff911f8, 7697e96a190e, af8a29b318b7].
Surat diamond exports declining by 7% alongside reported polishing wage and grey fabric defaults [698c779932f2, 975918f112f3, c4997bb35d98].
improvement_signals: GST Council granted Input Tax Credit (ITC) refunds and reduced highway inspections for Surat textiles [17f0a015a73c].
Surat is expanding its operations into defence technical textiles and establishing the ICA-GemLab facility [0f163b499572, 26bd1ecd549c].
Bridal demand is shifting toward larger lab-grown diamond stone sizes this wedding season [694aea903d0a].
what_to_watch: Monitor debt-servicing capacity and liquidity buffers in embroidery and loom units facing prolonged job-work disputes and input shocks.
Track developments regarding the upcoming state/central textile policies and their impact on power tariffs and capital subsidies.
Observe export recovery metrics for polished natural and lab-grown diamonds following UK regulatory scrutiny.
